notes: This record's own audit flag (gen 12, parent-too-young: age 12 at the 1612 birth of listed child 'Margaret', I182381536578) is resolved by the same finding as the Margaret/Isaac Myrick gen-11 case: 'Margaret' (I182381536578) is very likely a mislabeled copy of James Merrick (b.1612 Wales, d.1708 Newbury, MA), and this Thomas Merrick, per external genealogy (WikiTree Merrick-91, Merrick-10; the 1902 Merrick-Mirick-Myrick family genealogy), was almost certainly James's BROTHER -- one of four Merrick brothers who emigrated from Pembrokeshire, Wales to Charlestown, Massachusetts together in 1636 -- not his father, which would explain the impossible 12-year parent-child gap. Caveat: this tree's Thomas Merrick (b.1600, d.1684 Middletown, CT) does not precisely match the externally documented immigrant Thomas Merrick (b. abt.1620, d.1704 Springfield, MA), so the identification of this specific record with that specific external person is not certain; flagged, not corrected. See docs/research/ancestors/gen11-margaret-myrick.md.
